source.title: Anatomy MCQ: Thorax, Abdomen and Pelvis
source.authors: Szabo Bianca, Bartoș Adrian, Bartoș Dana

method: Printed numbered questionnaire items and printed answer-key letters are captured separately. Status is judged against the actual learning objective tested by the source item, not merely a shared topic label. direct = existing record tests substantially the same fact; partial = only some of the source item's tested detail is represented; gap = no suitable existing record identified in the inspected relevant banks. Chapters are manually matched against the live normal MCQ and True/False banks; printed answer-key letters are recorded as source metadata and are not endorsed as academically correct.
